row:
B&W Equine Vets are leading the field in equine care across the South West. We have a large team of highly qualified vets that are on hand to offer the best possible care to your horse, pony or donkey. From each of our 3 branches, Breadstone, Failand and Willesley, we provide a full first opinion service covering all aspects of veterinary care from routine vaccinations, dental care and health checks to lameness examinations and reproductive work. 

Should you ever need it, our state of the art hospital is staffed by a team of RCVS, European & American Recognised specialists in surgery, orthopaedics, diagnostic imaging, internal medicine, sports medicine and rehabilitation. With a full range of surgical, diagnostic and intensive care facilities we can offer the highest level of specialist care.
